text:
```yaml
name: Release Scrapers

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-scraper-binary:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      
      - name: Build scraper binary
        run: npm run build:scraper
      
      - name: Upload scraper binary as artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: scraper-latest
          path: dist/scrape.exe

  scrape-with-prebuilt-binary:
    needs: build-scraper-binary
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Download scraper binary
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: scraper-latest
      
      - name: Set SCRAPE environment variable
        run: echo "SCRAPE=./dist/scrape.exe" >> $GITHUB_ENV
      
      - name: Run scrape workflow
        run: make scrape_ocaml_planet
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up two jobs: one to build the scraper binary and another to use the pre-built binary in the `scrape.yml` workflow. The `build-scraper-binary` job checks out the repository, installs dependencies, builds the scraper binary, and uploads it as an artifact. The `scrape-with-prebuilt-binary` job downloads the pre-built binary, sets the `SCRAPE` environment variable, and runs the `make scrape_ocaml_planet` command.
